_README: Allowlist for the frontend `npm audit` CI gate (scripts/audit-check.mjs).
An entry here SUPPRESSES a high/critical advisory that would otherwise fail CI.
1. Fixing beats suppressing. Only add an entry when no non-breaking upgrade clears it.
2. `reason` must be a concrete, checkable not-applicable argument -- which vulnerable
code path exists and why THIS app never reaches it. 'It is noisy' is not a reason.
3. `remove_when` states the condition that retires the entry.
4. A stale entry (matches no current advisory) prints a non-fatal WARNING -- delete it.

advisories.title: React Router: RSC Mode CSRF Bypass Allows Action Execution Before 400 Response
reason: The vulnerability is reachable ONLY in React Router's RSC (React Server Components) mode,
where a server action can execute before the framework returns its 400 CSRF response.
This app has no RSC mode and no server at all in front of the router. Verified:
- no RSC imports anywhere in frontend/src (`react-router/rsc`, `unstable_RSC`, `RSCErrorHandler`);
- no SSR / static-handler APIs (`createStaticHandler`, `StaticRouter`, `renderToString`,
`renderToPipeableStream`);
- no server dependencies (`express`, `@react-router/node`, `@react-router/serve`);
- the router is a plain client-side <BrowserRouter> in frontend/src/App.tsx;
- the build is a client-only `vite build` with no ssr configuration.
There is therefore no server action to execute and no CSRF boundary to bypass.
Also flagged transitively on `react-router-dom`, which has no advisory of its own.
advisories.remove_when: react-router is upgraded to >=8.3.0, which requires the v8 migration that drops react-router-dom (no v8 of react-router-dom exists; the package folds into react-router in v8, so clearing this means rewriting imports across ~59 pages).
advisories.do_not: Never run `npm audit fix --force` for this: it resolves react-router-dom DOWN to 7.11.0 and reintroduces four advisories that were patched in 7.18.0.

advisories.title: brace-expansion: DoS via unbounded expansion length causing an out-of-memory process crash
reason: brace-expansion is a DEVELOPMENT-ONLY transitive dependency. It ships in nothing.
Verified: `npm ls brace-expansion --all --omit=dev` resolves to EMPTY -- every path into
this app runs through lint/test tooling only:
- eslint 9.x and @eslint/config-array / @eslint/eslintrc (via minimatch 3.x);
- eslint-plugin-react and eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y (via minimatch 3.x);
- @typescript-eslint/* (via minimatch 9.x);
- jest / ts-jest / @jest/transform / test-exclude / babel-plugin-istanbul.
The `vite build` client bundle contains none of it, so no deployed artifact is affected.
The vulnerability is a DoS: a crafted brace pattern expands unboundedly and OOMs the
process. Reaching it requires feeding an attacker-controlled glob/brace pattern to
minimatch. The only patterns these tools expand are the repo's own developer-authored
globs in eslint.config / jest.config / package.json scripts -- no runtime input, no user
input, and no production request path reaches them.
Honest scope note: CI does run eslint/jest on PR branches, so a PR author can influence
those config globs. That is not a meaningful escalation -- a PR that can edit jest.config
can already exhaust the runner directly (infinite loop in a test). The blast radius either
way is a crashed ephemeral CI job, never the shipped app or production data.
advisories.remove_when: Any consumer upgrade pulls a patched brace-expansion (>=5.0.8). Blocked today because 5.0.8 is the ONLY patched release and its API is incompatible with the minimatch 3.x that eslint's plugin set pins -- verified by forcing `overrides: {"brace-expansion": "^5.0.8"}`, which clears the advisory but breaks `npm run lint` with `TypeError: expand is not a function` in @eslint/config-array. Retire this entry when eslint + eslint-plugin-react + eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y move to a minimatch that accepts brace-expansion 5.x.
advisories.do_not: Do not add a blanket `brace-expansion` override to force 5.0.8 -- it breaks eslint outright (see remove_when). npm's own `fixAvailable` suggestions here are semver-major and include a nonsensical DOWNGRADE to jest 25.
